provenance.modifications: 1 real Eagle Point Park entry, South Loop and Central Loop paths stitched through the OSM graph, heading Gaussian-smoothed, positions re-integrated from heading, then pinned back onto the real junctions (largest drift closed 0.0 m, spread back along each line), resampled at 1.5 m with curvature from the sampled positions; land elevation from 3DEP low-pass filtered, bridge decks synthesized (3DEP is bare earth); lanes simplified to the configured cross-section; junction connector roads synthesized (a turn, a straight and a turn)

meta.notes: One traversal of Eagle Point Park entry, South Loop and Central Loop, ending before the lodge junction. OSM line and actual USGS terrain; main approach two-way, loops forward-only following the city road-map arrows. No North Loop, pedestrian bridge, alternate or repeated-edge lap. Widths are arcade adaptations, not surveyed: entry two 3 m lanes plus 1.5 m shoulders each side; loops one 3 m lane; 0.5 m soft grass verges. The 8.94 m/s traffic pace and paved-shoulder patrol marker are gameplay choices, not surveyed signs or a real parking lot. No claim about current on-site motorcycle access or exact retaining-wall positions.
